discription: Two slightly detuned saw waves processed through a resonant low-pass filter, with filter cutoff modulated by an ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attackTime=0.01, decayTime=0.1, sustainLevel=0.8, releaseTime=1.0, resonance=0.5, cutoff=4000;    var sig, env;    env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(attackTime, decayTime, sustainLevel, releaseTime, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var saw1 = Saw.ar(freq);    var saw2 = Saw.ar(freq * 1.005);    sig = (saw1 + saw2) * 0.5;    var filterEnvAmt = env.linlin(0, 1, 0.2, 1.0);    var modulatedCutoff = cutoff * (1 + filterEnvAmt * 2);    sig = RLPF.ar(sig, modulatedCutoff, resonance);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
